name: Southeastern Machining & Field
old_description: Custom fabrication, welding, safety guarding, platforms, dust collectors, repairs, and material handling equipment
about:
Southeastern Machining and Field Service, Inc. operates from a 22,000-square-foot facility in Lancaster, Ohio. The company provides machining, fabrication, engineering, and on-site industrial services to customers across the region.

The shop runs a mix of CNC equipment including an Okuma MB-5000H horizontal machining center, two Haas VF4 vertical machining centers with 50-by-20-by-25-inch travel, and an Okuma Genos L3000e turning center. Its fabrication department handles weld repair, machine rebuilds, safety guarding, platforms, dust collectors, and material-handling equipment. Engineering services cover SolidWorks design, reverse engineering, fixture design, and machine integration. On-site crews perform plant maintenance, shutdown support, equipment installation, and field welding.

The company serves manufacturing and industrial clients needing anything from single prototype parts to long-term production contracts, as well as plants requiring in-house maintenance and rebuild expertise.

Management emphasizes that the facility's size allows a diverse machine mix and flexibility that larger competitors cannot match, while the ISO 9001:2015 quality system formalizes processes for consistent output. The firm positions itself as large enough for volume work but small enough to deliver personal service.
